name: Fragmentation
description: A body in the Fragmented State: a cluster of cyan fragments held at the point of collapse.
role: The canonical look of every entity that falls; it holds until the body reintegrates.

artBrief.spriteScale: A character of a 2×2 cell footprint.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)
artBrief.silhouette: The outline of a figure broken into shards.
artBrief.detail: Cyan shards with white glints and deep blue gaps; no face.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Cyans #6bffff and #96ffff, blues #156d99 and #204e6a, white glints.
